description.value: Togo Sushi is a quick-service sushi chain with a location inside Richmond Centre mall, built around the concept of fresh sushi made to go. The brand operates across Metro Vancouver with an app-based and web ordering system. A touring cyclist stopping here would find fast, portable Japanese food in a large indoor shopping centre environment.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces, covered) at 30m; rack (4 spaces, covered) at 82m. Total: 8 spaces.
